Check that every student repository's assignment document parses

Source: R/project.R
parse_project.Rd

Locates each student repository's assignment document (discovered from the project config's repos directory and matched by the stored template's source.path basename when a template exists) and parses it with parse_assignment_document(), reporting the outcome per repository. The q2r parser is strict, so small markdown slips in a submission (a stray $ or {, an unclosed quote, emphasis mark, or bracket, malformed YAML front matter) fail the parse and leave the repository ungradable until repaired. This headless check finds them and returns the parser's diagnostic verbatim, which is what the bundled markermd-fix-parsing skill works from; unlike validate_project() it needs no stored template.

Usage

parse_project(path = ".", use_qmd = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Path to an initialized markermd project directory.

use_qmd

Logical. Match .qmd files (TRUE, the default) or .Rmd files (FALSE).

Value

A data frame with one row per repository and columns repo, file (path of the document that was parsed, NA when none was found), status ("ok", "warning", "error", or "missing"), and detail (the parser's diagnostics with ANSI styling stripped, or NA when there are none).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res = parse_project("hw01")
res[res$status != "ok", ]
} # }
